games.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Soundtrack
PARTNERS IN PANIC - asymmetric CO-OP driving game
Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. Soundtrack
3AM Drivethrough
games.summary: Work the night shift at a 24-hour drive-thru. Take orders, cook the food and hand it out the window. But some customers aren’t human. Check every face, car and order, and refuse the ones that don’t match, or they’ll come back for you before dawn. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: 5 Nights at Data Center
games.summary: Walter Kessler works the night shift at a data center that is always quiet, always cold, and never quite right. Five nights of first-person psychological horror: clear the alerts, walk the halls, answer the radio, and make it to six.

games.name: 666 (Define Infinity)
games.summary: 666. The devil has spoken. She wants you to roll the dice. Why? Nobody knows. She needs a six. Then maybe another. Then maybe 666. A short dice rolling game: throw, buy upgrades that bend the odds, and keep rolling until she gets what she wants.

games.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn
games.summary: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night

games.name: A.N.S.I.A.
games.summary: It's your first day at ANSIA. Review citizens' paperwork according to regulations that change every day, growing more absurd by the minute. A satire of Italian bureaucracy inspired by Papers, Please, with 4 different endings.

games.name: Alchedoom
games.summary: A first-person alchemy roguelite. Wake in a dark lord's cell. Refine pills as tribute to survive. Handle pills, add ingredients, use fire. Success, damage or ruin: decide when to stop. Combine relics, catalysts and fire seeds to bend the odds. Face new trials daily. Will you live to escape?

games.name: Alph Last Bastion
games.summary: The bug swarm is coming, and your bastion is the last thing standing in its way. Build a fortress of turrets anywhere on the battlefield, power it up, and hold the line against relentless hordes and monstrous bosses. Fall, upgrade your arsenal, and return stronger.

games.name: Altertum
games.summary: 地上とダンジョンを自由に探索しつつ、入手した素材で武器や道具を製造したり、自分の家をカスタマイズしたり、旅人となり自由に旅をしつつ、帝国が管理する歴史書を巡って巻き起こる騒動を追いかけ、隠された歴史を紐解いていく探索系RPG。

games.name: Arteria
games.summary: Build roads, intersections, and tram lines. The city grows on its own along the roads you lay. Ease congestion and turn a village into a metropolis.

games.name: ASAGE
games.summary: A short hand-drawn adventure set in a serene blue-green forest. The only thing you can do on the world map is pray. Meet the forest's residents and complete a traditional Japanese breakfast known as Asage through a series of charming, slightly strange minigames.

games.name: Ascension Tournament
games.summary: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.

games.name: Ball Pit Cleanup
games.summary: Sort thousands of colorful balls into matching pipes. Unlock upgrades and work more efficiently, but be careful: every mistake adds more balls to the pile.

games.name: Battlegenics
games.summary: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

games.name: Beauty Store Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Organize mountains of cosmetics, arrange beautiful displays, and create the perfect beauty store! Relax and tidy up solo or with up to 4 players in this cozy first-person organizing simulator.

games.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
games.summary: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

games.name: BLOWHOLE
games.summary: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

games.name: Brick Mayhem
games.summary: Brick Mayhem is a chaotic and funny autobattler where tiny plastic warriors fight, break apart, and destroy everything around them. Customize your characters, build ridiculous battles, and enjoy physics-driven mayhem.

games.name: Business Tycoon (Tycoon Games)
games.summary: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

games.name: Choo chop
games.summary: Hop aboard and play in bite-sized days! A relaxing incremental game where your train rolls through the forest while your lumberjacks fell every tree in reach. Logs fly into the wagons, the wagons fire saws and drones, and every upgrade makes the next day bigger. Just one more day!

games.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator - First Bite
games.summary: Get your first taste of running a bakery in space in this free introduction to Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator. Bake sweet treats, serve coffee, put your robot helper to work, and adopt a cat — solo or with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: CRED
games.summary: CRED is a sci-fi story-based narrative game with operating-system simulation features and a worldview centered around ananomaly-management organization. Players will experience a series of events and make fateful choices as they learn more abouthe organization and the universe it is in.

games.name: Custimity
games.summary: Online arena Action RPG: fight PvE waves, duel players in PvP, and build powerful skill and item loadouts. Between clashes, bet on rival fights — read builds, trust your instincts, and turn sharp calls into gold. Survive, outplay, and climb the ranks.

games.name: Dark Type On Tumour Humour
games.summary: ?Funny? Typing Game where you run through letters to type out jokes. Errors, Time, HIGH SCORE!

games.name: DEADWICK
games.summary: The house should be empty, yet a light is burning inside. Shoot down the dead closing in, rescue the people who were taken, and destroy the source of it all. A first-person horror rail shooter that drives you through the house. Also supports 2-player online co-op.

games.name: Deja-Vu of the Dead
games.summary: Drink. Die. Repeat. When a mysterious experimental sparks a city-wide zombie outbreak you find yourself trapped in a 25-minute temporal time loop. Every decision you make matters. Explore an interconnected city, talk to fully voiced survivors, collect weapons, and uncover 23 distinct endings.

games.name: Demon Expulsion
games.summary: A short horror game. It looks like a nightmare, but it is not. This is a demon expulsion.

games.name: DERELIKT
games.summary:
Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, Alien Resurrection, Doom 3, and, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help.

Von Neumann Outpost is a remote research station built into a derelict asteroid in Saturn’s orbit. Now its halls are dark, its systems are failing, and the few survivors left inside aren't telling the same story.

Explore the outpost’s secrets, its corridors, labs, maintenance shafts, and crew quarters. And venture deeper into stranger places inside the rock. Search for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new routes through a station that grows more dangerous the deeper you go.

games.name: Desktop Goblins
games.summary: A village of tiny goblins moves onto your desktop. They build huts on your icons, mine for gems, throw parties, start fires, go on strike, and if you poke them too much, they declare war on your mouse cursor.

games.name: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG Demo
DesktopKins
games.summary: This is a Desktop Companion Engine with a unique twist! Control your avatar companions and play parkour in your screen, they can interact with windows, icons and screen borders. There is a mini game with 3 levels that you can play as well when you need a break! This brings joy to your Desktop :)

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.summary: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: Don't Blow UP!
games.summary: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.

games.name: Doomfield:The Maze
games.summary: Doomfield: The Maze is a single-player horror minigame where you explore a cornfield maze to find your missing dog while evading two deadly virus entities. Venture off the main path to discover hidden areas where the digital memory grows increasingly distorted.

games.name: Door Code
games.summary: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.

games.name: Dusteroids
games.summary: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

games.name: Earl's Court
games.summary: Your car broke down on County Road 17. The old man in the farmhouse would like to play a game first. Western trivia, just a quick one. Answer well and you get your phone call. Answer badly and Earl decides.

games.name: EAT Your Way Out
games.summary: Eat your way through a Mediterranean holiday property buried in living green jelly. Carve paths with a spoon, manage your stomach, deposit what you swallow, upgrade strange tools, uncover shortcuts, and escape before the mass reveals its secret.

games.name: Endless Loot
games.summary: Minimal-control dark loot RPG. Click to fight; skills auto-cast. Descend, kill, loot—grow stronger as you go. No town, no turning back. One pit, always down.

games.name: Epoch Vault
games.summary: Bring life back to a world shattered by Earth’s greatest mass extinction. Discover ancient creatures, watch ecosystems recover, and trace life’s journey from the survivors to the rise of the first dinosaurs in an atmospheric idle game set in the Triassic.

games.name: Evercoil
games.summary: Eat, grow, and trap rival snakes with your own body in an endless Snake survival game. Open up a larger arena, dodge lava and fireballs, and save powers for a tight spot. Keep your gold when you die, buy permanent upgrades, and have another go.

games.name: Family Business
games.summary: Family Business is a horror game where you work in your uncle’s burger shop. Prepare food, serve it to customers, make new friends and uncover the mystery surrounding your family.

games.name: Farm Business Simulator
games.summary: Turn a small backyard into a farm that supplies an entire town. Grow crops, make goods, deliver orders and expand your business — solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

games.name: Feypath
games.summary: Feypath is a single button precision platformer that is suitable for those that like punishing but fair gameplay. Save the princess and uncover the secrets of the Demon Kingdom by jumping to the top of the world!

games.name: Fox in a Field
games.summary: In this fresh new take on the classic Minesweeper, cross the field one step at a time. Find your babies on the way to the exit. Move around obstacles and find hidden objects in the field too! If you ever enjoyed mine sweeper you will love my game. Choose quick play or Quest through 100 levels

games.name: Free Company
games.summary: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

games.name: Goblin And Glory
games.summary: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

games.name: Guild of Champions
games.summary: Run an e-sports organization on the road to Worlds. Sign and trade pro players, set the lineup and training, then draft and command your team in live 5v5 arena matches, or simulate them. Manage money, morale and chemistry season after season.

games.name: Helbreath Mystic Tavern Classic
games.summary: Rise, level up, and arm yourself for an endless war between two rival nations. Choose your allegiance and carve a path of destruction through your enemies in this reimagined and customized world of Helbreath.

games.name: Hellterns
games.summary: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

games.name: HoloCozy
games.summary: HoloCozy is a cozy idle desktop companion where you can spend relaxing time with hololive talents in their rooms. Enjoy music and ambient sounds, keep your favorite characters close, and watch them grow at your own pace while you work, study, or unwind.

games.name: Hook & Loot
games.summary: Hook & Loot is a relaxing single-player magnet fishing game. Clear an autumn lake of 1,458 metal objects. Haul in scrap and rare finds, bring your catches to the scrapyard, and upgrade your gear.

games.name: Horror Stories: Social Problems
games.summary: An unsettling blend of life simulation and psychological horror with PSX style visuals. Rebuild your life, find a job, explore the town, do anything for ALISA

games.name: Idle Purrates Clicker
games.summary: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

games.name: Inkturn
games.summary: A puzzle game about leaving the right trail. You coordinate two inkfish to collect every star. Collecting a star switches control to the other inkfish. Each fish leaves a trail that blocks it but enables the other.

games.name: Keep Farming Aura
games.summary: Farm Aura and turn every move into momentum. Attract a crowd, build your crew, unlock upgrades and face powerful rivals as you grow from an unknown into an Aura legend in this active 3D incremental game.

games.name: Kinetile
games.summary: Build a route for one rolling ball, then let physics test your plan. Arrange jumps, teleports and sliding platforms in this 3D puzzle. Solve 56 handcrafted levels, then keep going with endless generated puzzles in Infinity mode.

games.name: Kitty Killshot
games.summary: A Survival FPS where you scavenge broken pottery fragments to craft new pots while fending off kitties determined to smash your fragile pots. Once crafted, your precious pots need to be extracted out of the warehouse and safely delivered.

games.name: Lia's Rolling Club
games.summary: Lia’s Rolling Club is a satisfying incremental game about rolling joints, stacking cash, and chasing jackpots. Upgrade and automate to hypnotic trap and plugg beats. Survive an increasingly chaotic arena shooter, climb the leaderboards, and uncover Lia’s mysterious story.

games.name: Loot Survivors
games.summary: Survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

games.name: Lost Luggage
games.summary: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.

games.name: Lowbar Legends
games.summary: The idle MMO that lives above your Windows taskbar. Chop, smelt, slay and raid with your clan while you work. Every item you loot trades on the Steam Community Market · gear, keys, chests, even the pets. Free to play. No ads, no energy, no subscription.

games.name: Mart: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Tidy up to 19,026 objects across a two-floor store with 25 departments. Pick up products, restock shelves, fold clothes and earn upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players.

games.name: MazeStudio
games.summary: Welcome to Mazestudio! You can freely create their very own mazes. In Mazestudio, it only takes 3 simple steps: upload any local image，travel photos, cute pet pictures, artworks, or even phone screenshots, adjust the maze difficulty freely, and generate your custom maze challenge with one click.

games.name: MAZRAP
games.summary: Zoo returns a rented outfit after closing. The clothes are accepted... but she is scanned as the overdue item. A short psychological horror visual novel about being agreeable, being owned, and a friendship that doesn't fit on the returns form.

games.name: MESA
games.summary: MESA is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. Play as a patient as you traverse and escape from the facility that you are being held at while avoiding or fighting enemies that may be real or an illusion.

games.name: Minesweeper Quest
games.summary: Turn familiar Minesweeper logic into an expedition. Mark hidden mines, find safe routes and uncover the Crystal Mine's secret. Explore 1,380 puzzles and 24 rule types, with hints that explain the reasoning behind your next move.

games.name: MOGA TD
games.summary: Friendships are forged by beating something hard together. MOGA TD is a co-op tower defense for four: one shared board, one pool of lives, four races that cannot win alone — against four element armies, their kings and the Orc Warlord. Nobody holds the Gate alone.

games.name: Monster Girl Tactics: Oubliette
games.summary: An SRPG featuring feisty and ambitious monstergirls, branching romance, and an unconventional essence. From the downtrodden rise a revolting mafia; join them in a wild hunt for power, revenge, change... and love.

games.name: Murder Mystery Online
games.summary: A first-person 3D online murder mystery for you and your friends. Each player takes a role, walks the same crime scene, hunts for clues, and argues their way to the truth. Start with a free case. For paid episodes, one player buys and the whole group joins.

games.name: Music Empire Tycoon
games.summary: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.

games.name: Mutual Occult Insurance
games.summary: Mutual Occult Insurance is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror and corporate satire. You are a field agent for the only insurer that covers supernatural damage. Fraud or not, whatever did this has not left the building. Approve or deny the claim… if you live long enough to file it.

games.name: Next Orbit
games.summary: Build your deck, outsmart your enemies, and help Norma repair the Next Orbit in this turn-based card game set in a world where technology and nature collide

games.name: No More Monsters
games.summary: It's time to challenge the monsters of Arvelia! Become one of the world's mightiest mages, slay thousands of creatures, and claim their power. They thought this world belonged to them. Prove them wrong. They used to be the hunters. Now they're the prey. No More Monsters!

games.name: Outralism
games.summary: A minimalist black-and-white rhythm game made for modding. Play songs from the Steam Workshop, chart your own, write Lua mods in the game's own editor, and play together in Steam lobbies of up to 16 players.

games.name: Palehollow Hospital
games.summary: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

games.name: Panic Pub
games.summary: Panic Pub is a chaotic co-op pub management simulation where you serve customers, manage orders, and survive escalating chaos. Play solo or with up to 4 players in local or online co-op as everything quickly spirals out of control.

games.name: Paper Racer
games.summary: Paper Racer is the racing game on squared paper, the one from your school exercise book. Move by move you set your line across the sheet and carry speed into the corners — brake too late and you land in the gravel. Draw your own tracks and race the computer or friends, locally or online.

games.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator
games.summary: Run a parcel inspection desk. Weigh, X-ray and look up every shipment, compare it with the declaration and the latest regulations, then stamp and route it: approve, return, hold, confiscate or dispose. Earn cash, upgrade your workplace and keep up with a growing quota.

games.name: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
games.summary: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.

games.name: PERI.CO
games.summary: ==SAVE $3.99 NOW with a FREE CREDIT & XP BONUS (7 Day) and CUSTOM APPGRATIS UPGRADE ITEM==Fight in real-time online mech combat.  Customize your mechs, each with unique abilities to get an edge in a skirmish.  Battle in competitive 8 player multiplayer combat in an arena full of surprises and strategy! Apply Upgrades or improve your Tech to your play style!iMech Online is a true competitive and online shooter where you play in real-time combat against real life players. games.name: Pinball Hero
games.summary: Hero Pinball is a turn-based pinball RPG roguelike on an arcade cabinet. Heroes and skills are physical marbles—load boxes, launch, and let physics settle the fight. Climb a branching map, grow builds through play, recruit allies, and clear the table.

games.name: Port Solano City: Gangster War
games.summary: Come home to Port Solano as Jay Brooks and rise through its criminal underworld. Steal cars, take over gang turf, survive five-star police chases and fly helicopters and fighter jets across an open city full of side jobs, properties to buy and changing weather.

games.name: Primal Breakout
games.summary: You are the first dinosaur to break out of the lab. Fight through fifteen worlds, raise fifteen prehistoric beasts and build a skill tree of 28 abilities – an incremental where a strike at the right moment deals almost double.

games.name: Provinces (PezhetGames)
games.summary: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

games.name: Puzzle Simulator
games.summary: Unwind with a puzzle and skip the fortune, the sore back and the pieces lost under the sofa. Tip out the box, flip the pieces and relax into the click. Any photo can be your next puzzle.

games.name: Quack
games.summary: QUACK is a physics-based party minigame collection where up to 4 ducks tilt, blast, and outlast each other to avoid being eliminated first, playable locally, with bots, or online through Steam.

games.name: QUTAS67 - Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
games.summary: QUTAS 67 is a clicker game set in the year 2067, where players build a criminal empire by clicking and hiring managers to rob increasingly larger buildings with the ultimate goal of finally "releasing" the iconic, endlessly delayed game. 6️⃣7️⃣

games.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
games.summary: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

games.name: Ratanoid
games.summary: Two rats, a lot of balls, and even more cheese. Run, jump and bounce balls off wooden logs to smash 100 levels of cheese blocks. No lives: drop all the balls and the cheese falls on your head instead. Play solo with both rats or race a friend for the high score.

games.name: Re2 I Rise Alone
games.summary: A Raising + Romance Interactive FMV Game: Step into the shoes of an underdog and live out the ultimate rags-to-riches power fantasy. Brawling, character building, boozing and flirting — all kinds of gameplay in one explosive package! A massive 100GB of content! Redefining your thrill ride!

games.name: Reperta
games.summary: An idle collecting game where no two finds are alike. Pick a world, press EXPLORE, and every artifact comes out with its own rarity, finish, preservation and a serial number counted across the whole server. 104 artifacts, 8 finishes, 16 worlds and a player Market. Any roll can be the one.

games.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters
games.summary: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.

games.name: Save the Sandcastle
games.summary: The tide is coming. Dig for sand, build defences and guide the water across 36 beach puzzles. Keep your sandcastle standing, manage your stamina and improve your construction through further tides in Endless.

games.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27
games.summary: Setter is a volleyball management game where every decision shapes your club. Build and develop your squad in a competitive transfer market where rivals can bid for your players, prepare your lineup and tactics, and watch every rally unfold as you compete for domestic titles and continental success.

games.name: Shield Line: Riot Police Tactics Demo
Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash
games.summary: SHUTTLE HEARTS - ACADEMY SMASH is a fast-paced 2D arcade-style badminton game featuring girls with unique abilities and special moves. Master a variety of shots, unleash SP Shots and SP Skills, and enjoy Story Mode or jump into Versus Mode for CPU battles and local two-player matches.

games.name: Sort and Stack!
games.summary: Bring order to chaotic card piles in this fast-paced puzzle game where strategic sorting triggers massive math-based score multipliers and unlocks beautiful handdrawn artwork.

games.name: Spirit Tide
games.summary: Cast your line into the ocean in Spirit Tide, a simple 2D fishing simulator! Catch legendary fish, discover new species, earn coins, and upgrade your fishing rods. Explore exciting ocean events and see what awaits you beneath the waves! Available for only €0.99!

games.name: Stadt Land Fluss with friends
games.summary: Stadt, Land, Fluss für euren nächsten Online-Spieleabend: Ob Stadt, Land, Serienfigur oder Fund im WG-Kühlschrank, wählt klassische Kategorien oder denkt euch eigene aus. Stell dein Wissen auch allein auf die Probe und finde immer neue Begriffe in abwechslungsreichen Spielmodi.

games.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector
games.summary: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!

games.name: Sudoku Supreme
games.summary: Sudoku, beautifully set. 200 puzzles across four difficulty levels - Easy, Medium, Hard and Supreme. Every puzzle has one unique solution, with difficulty shaped by the logic it takes to solve it.

games.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness
games.summary: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where your weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons, build an unlimited arsenal, and face towering bosses. Survive each chamber, defeat its guardian, and descend deeper into darkness.

games.name: The Friendly Monster
games.summary: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

games.name: The Liminal Cleaner - The Pools
games.summary: An atmospheric pixel-art cleaning game set in the Poolrooms. Explore abandoned pools and corridors, recover your tools, and scrub away grime using four cleaning methods. Watch the world change as you restore each area and uncover its secrets.

games.name: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty
games.summary: Bob the Monkey has fled from the circus and the trainer is chasing him. Match the cards of fate before Bob is caught. Monkey Match Mayhem is a unique twist on card matching game. Match the cards in fastest possible time and compete with friends through Game Center. Earn Achievements as you complete the levels.Unlock higher levels to increase the difficulty. Match more cards. Test your memory!Free-version is Ad-supported. Buy full-version to remove advertisements and unlock additional difficulty modes. Be the first one to win on IMPOSSIBLE difficulty. Put your memory to test. Save Bob The Monkey!Features:√ Match cards to save Bob the Monkey.√ Put your brain cells to test.√ 6 Difficulty levels to play.√ Compete for high score against friends through Game Center.√ Over 20 Achievements to unlock!

games.name: Three Kingdoms: Devour the World
games.summary: A pixel-art idle strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms. Recruit 193 generals, build your team, set formations and assign treatises, then watch them fight through 57 campaigns, from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the rise of Jin, and on into the Immortal Trial and the Demon Realm.

games.name: Tidy Up the Magic Mess
games.summary: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.

games.name: Tiny Trawler
games.summary: A cozy top-down fishing game set on the Norwegian coast. Start with a handline on the dock, then work your way up to your own fleet – from a little dinghy to a shrimp trawler. Chase 55 species, follow the rumours, and sail home under lantern light.

games.name: Void Revenant
games.summary: Blast through 20 sectors in a pixel-art vertical shoot ’em up. Collect salvage, dock with an alien merchant and build an arsenal of lasers, missiles and drones. Break gigantic bosses, chase explosive combos and unlock new ships across four difficulties.

games.name: Wanderbound
games.summary: Leave the beaten path and set off into a cozy world that builds itself as you explore it. Create, observe, catch, gather, camp and climb your way through the seasons.

games.name: Wannabe Trading Master
games.summary: Fifty thousand yuan, a losing position, and a boss behind your chair. Trade fictional stocks in a roguelite life sim, judge rumors, dodge scams, build your strategy, and survive quarterly life checks. Simplified Chinese only.

games.name: Warrior Quest
games.summary: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

games.name: Water TD
games.summary: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

games.name: We March as One
games.summary: Can you name all football clubs by their logo? Guess hundred of logos in 5 difficulty levels - additional in-App purchase free!!

games.name: Which Sausage, Mate? - 1980: Under the Counter
Wonderjack
games.summary: Play the famous Blackjack but with a twist in this Alice in the Wonderland themed game.

games.name: Wrong Tank!
games.summary: Three tanks. One arriving fish. Read its request, inspect the habitats, and send it to the right home. Build clean placement chains across 50 handcrafted shifts in this colorful pixel art aquarium puzzle game.

games.name: YASUKE CHRONICLES
games.summary: Fight through history with Yasuke and Napoleon in a 3D action RPG. Cut through crowds with ink slashes, parry powerful bosses, and collect weapons with up to five War Sigils. Forge your favorite weapon, combine relics, and conquer changing battlefields across four difficulties.

games.name: YoYo Blade
games.summary: "Animal Farm" is a fun puzzle game intended for kids between ages 2 and 6."Animal Farm" takes children on a journey through a farm, where they encounter a wide variety of animals. Using drag-and-drop actions, the pieces of the puzzle can be arranged into the proper places to form the animals, and once successful, the kids are rewarded with an exciting display of sounds and balloons.

games.name: ZULMARASH: Echoes of Zaltar
games.summary: A turn-based, tile-by-tile tactical RPG in pixel art. Randomized loot in five rarities, gear that shows on your hero, generated dungeons, spreading fire. And a living village where the children sing at vespers. Several endings.

games.name: Civilization integration
games.summary: A history-driven merge puzzler. Water meets fire and becomes steam; steam pushes the first machine — 223 elements, 10 Chinese dynasties, 74 levels, from a Stone Age campfire to a Qing-era firearms workshop. Every invention cites a real source.

games.name: Fruit Kombat
games.summary: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.

games.name: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
games.summary: 这是一款 AI互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前夜的香港，你将扮演李洋，爱情拉扯、家族博弈与真相交织，她们不是等待被攻略的角色，而是拥有各自立场、伤口与命运的人。你要做的不只是选择所爱， 时代潮水来临前，你会做出怎样的选择?

games.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
games.summary: Relive the past with Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure! You are Ilenor the Brave, who has had 4 precious items stolen from him (including his cat, Shadowtongue!), and it's up to you to help him get them back by guiding him through 36 levels of pure chaos, filled with various enemies and deathtraps!

games.name: Beast & Bloom: Tower Defense
games.summary: Beast & Bloom blends maze-building tower defense, random recruitment, and three-way fusion. Recruit adorable guardians, shape enemy paths, and fuse powerful allies. Use magical items to turn obstacles into guardians and grant anti-air powers. Defend your forest against ground and flying foes!

games.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!
games.summary: Thousands of fruit lie scattered across a sunny terraced market. Pick them up, carry them to the right stall and set each one into neat, satisfying rows. No timer, no fail state: just you, 4,000+ pieces of fruit and the quiet joy of putting everything in its place.

games.name: Blind Katana: The Ember Keeper
games.summary: Samurai action as a blind swordsman who sees by sound. In the [Eternal Night], enemy footsteps become waves of light that reveal where they are. Read the dark, slash, guard, roll and execute foes. Pick a card each stage to build your swordplay, and face the [Darkest Hour], who stole the [Ember].

games.name: Chisel Me This
games.summary: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

games.name: Code Market
games.summary: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

games.name: Crossroad Chaos
games.summary: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.

games.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
games.summary: Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, hire the crew, wire the power and plumbing, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests fed, rested and happy - while the weather, the sea and your own floor plans do their best to stop you.

games.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
games.summary: Build a binder of golden cards and carry it across a connected roguelike adventure. Choose a hero, collect and upgrade cards, battle monsters, explore dungeons, and discover how familiar cards transform in each new challenge.

games.name: Don't Drop!!
games.summary: “Don't Drop!!” is a challenging 3D action game that captures the essence of platformers. Control the ball using only jump commands as you aim for the top of the tower! Go through repeated trial and error, and experience the thrill of gradually clearing each level!

games.name: Dungeonbound
games.summary: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

games.name: FOG (Nafuboay)
games.summary: FOG is a role-playing game centered on combat and character progression, incorporating elements such as Minesweeper. It features mechanics like chain fog-clearing, allowing even newcomers unfamiliar with traditional Minesweeper rules to pick it up quickly.

games.name: HauntedHouseNO14
games.summary: HauntedHouseNO14 is a first‑person psychological horror game offering an immersive terrifying experience. Investigate an old unsolved case, encounter all sorts of uncanny and bizarre occurrences, and gradually unearth the dark truth that has been covered up.

games.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
games.summary: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.

games.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
games.summary: An incremental about one simple question. How many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

games.name: Impression Cabinet
games.summary: Assemble a curated collection of archival images and designed prints. Sort and rotate pieces across the table, reveal finished interpretations, inspect selected prints in Second Look, and file your work into the Cabinet.

games.name: Jyoka -Castle town-
games.summary: "Jyoka" is a castle town-building strategy game set in 16th-century Japan. Players select a territory from the map of Japan, hire retainers, gather local resources, and construct various buildings. The game also features defensive battles to protect the castle and sieges to attack enemy strongholds.

games.name: Nano Reef
games.summary: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

games.name: Pending Review
games.summary: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.

games.name: Point Nemo
games.summary: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs a part from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.

games.name: Snake Echos
games.summary: Totally addictive classic card game, how far can you go?WHAT IS HIGHER OR LOWER?Higher or Lower is a classic card game for all your iOS devices. Simply guess whether the next card is higher or lower and see how far you can get. You have 3 lives and unlimited cards. How do you compare to the rest of the world?FEATURES? Game Center integration? Worldwide leaderboards and achievements? See how you compare to your friends? Gorgeous retina graphics for both iPhone and iPadCOMING SOON? More languagesAny comments, problems or feature requests tweet us at http://twitter.com/tapboxltd

games.name: That's My Life
games.summary: That's My Life is a deep life simulation sandbox where multiple systems connect inside one persistent world. Build a career, study, run businesses, invest, own property, form relationships, enter politics or crime, and live with the consequences as every part of your life affects the others.

games.name: The Inkwright
games.summary: An ink-wash xianxia action game. You are your sect's most worthless disciple — spirit energy leaks right out of you. Then you learn the one technique only you can use: clash blades at the instant steel meets steel and take your enemy's power. Every win becomes a unique ink painting.

games.name: The Midnight Client
games.summary: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.

games.name: Tomo-chan's Cleaning Panic
games.summary: This is a fixed-screen action game reminiscent of 80s arcade titles. Use various items to clean floors and pick up trash—all while dodging rats and cockroaches—to tidy up the building within the time limit. The game features 30 levels in total and includes multiple endings

games.name: War Tiles: Napoleons Invasion of Russia
games.summary: SUMMER 1812, WITH EUROPE UNDER HIS HEAL AND BRITAIN NOT ACCEPTING ANY PEACE. NAPOLEON LEADS THE LARGEST ARMY EVER ASSEMBLED IN EUROPE. TO FINALY INVADE RUSSIA, CAN YOU QUICKLY CONQUER RUSSIA. WHILE MAKING SURE YOUR TROOPS KEEP UP THE PACE AND ARE SUPPLIED! BEFORE THE RUSSIAN WINTER?

games.name: When Ren Ran
games.summary: Ren put on a mask he found — and turned into a spirit. Now he must figure out what the local spirits want and help them to become human again. A bright fairy-tale point-and-click puzzle game, entirely handcrafted by a family of two.

games.name: Wuxiang Lake
games.summary: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

games.name: AURORA REQUIEM: The Lullaby of Calvaris
Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan - Wallpaper Pack
Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan Soundtrack
Breakfast Shop Legend
games.summary: Run a Taiwanese breakfast shop in this fast-paced time-management sim! Fry egg crepes, deep-fry nuggets, and mix drinks by hand. Every round ends in a frantic Rush Hour. Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

games.name: Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
Demockracy
games.summary: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

games.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree - Water Park
EmergenHex
games.summary: Solve combat puzzles with your build-crafted loadout, automate conquered nodes across a haunted hex map for loot, and upgrade your skills, passives, and gear. Master 70+ handcrafted encounters, then enter a harder phase where the rules change for all encounters!

games.name: Feed The Vessel
games.summary: An incremental game where you keep a hungry god fed across hundreds of light-years of empty space. Grow clones in vats, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

games.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush - Supporter Pack
Hack 42: Typing Incremental
games.summary: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

games.name: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
Imperionis
games.summary: Imperionis is a tactical RPG about a Roman commander. Develop your century, unlock new units and characters, resolve events through D20 checks, and fight hex-based battles and personal duels-manually or through real-time autobattle.

games.name: IWA Fighting Adventure
games.summary: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

games.name: Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!!
KEEP IT TIDY! Tiny Helpers Demo

Quiz Show Simulator
games.summary: Run your own high-stakes quiz show by crafting questions, choosing contestants, and making production decisions to grow your audience, boost ratings, and earn more money!

games.name: Raise, Rise & Die
games.summary: A dark fantasy deckbuilder duel. You are held together by the souls you've absorbed — and every card you play costs you another one. Sacrifice from your hand, channel it through your weapon, and bring your opponent down. Designed on a table, with real cards, before a single line of code.

games.name: Reypunk: An Eye For An Eye Demo
Sir, We Have a Pit Problem! Demo
Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Stickman Breaks Into the World of Mathematics
Swarmdle
games.summary: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, spend what you collect on weapons and upgrades between waves, and keep permanent upgrades when a run ends. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that every player in the world gets identically.

Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

Persona 4 Revival
games.summary:
In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
